**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.92. This is a proposal only. A human analyst decides.

**The three facts that drove it:**
1. T-X1009-02 is a registered market maker on SYN.A (ETF-MM desk). It quotes BUY and SELL together at 2464, its typical size and about 1.03x the top-5 depth. Cancel symmetry is 0.963, and each pair is re-quoted every 2–3 seconds.
2. 2464 filled on its own BUY quotes before any opposite-side trade, so the resting order was working (core feature (a) absent). Price moved 0 ticks in its favour with no reversion, and the round trip is −0.19 ticks (core feature (b) absent).
3. There were no market events and no repeated cycles in the session. The alert fired on gross quote-refresh volume against depth, not on a one-sided order.

**What would change my mind:** evidence that the BUY side was quoted one-sidedly, or that SELL fills followed a favourable move that reverted after a BUY cancel. Neither appears on this tape.

The prior CLOSE_FP on this same alert was context only. I based the proposal on the tape.
